description: Starter academic topic catalogue for course classification and recommendation.

topics.name: Computer Science
topics.description: Broad field covering computation, software, computer systems, data, and intelligent systems.

topics.name: Programming
topics.description: Programming concepts, language fundamentals, and the implementation of software.

topics.name: Algorithms
topics.description: Design, analysis, and implementation of algorithms and computational problem-solving methods.

topics.name: Data Structures
topics.description: Methods for organizing, storing, and accessing data, including arrays, trees, graphs, and hash tables.

topics.name: Computer Systems
topics.description: The organization and operation of computer hardware, operating systems, and low-level software.

topics.name: Operating Systems
topics.description: Operating-system concepts including processes, threads, scheduling, memory management, and system interfaces.

topics.name: Concurrency
topics.description: Concurrent execution, synchronization, coordination, and communication between tasks or threads.

topics.name: Computer Networking
topics.description: Network architecture, communication protocols, network services, and data transmission.

topics.name: Network Security
topics.description: Security of networked systems, including network threats, defensive controls, monitoring, and secure communication.

topics.name: Embedded Systems
topics.description: Computing systems built into devices, including microcontrollers, firmware, and hardware-software interaction.

topics.name: Internet of Things
topics.description: Connected physical devices and systems that sense, exchange, and act on data over networks.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence
topics.description: Computational methods for tasks associated with intelligent behaviour, reasoning, perception, and decision-making.

topics.name: Machine Learning
topics.description: Methods that enable computational models to learn patterns from data for prediction, classification, or decision-making.

topics.name: AI Engineering
topics.description: Engineering practices for building, integrating, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered applications and systems.

topics.name: Data Science
topics.description: Extracting knowledge and insights from data through data preparation, analysis, statistics, and visualization.

topics.name: Cloud Computing
topics.description: Computing services and infrastructure delivered over networks, including cloud platforms, deployment, and resource management.

topics.name: Software Engineering
topics.description: Methods and practices for specifying, designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software systems.

topics.name: Software Architecture
topics.description: The high-level structure of software systems, including components, interfaces, design decisions, and architectural styles.
